# Outline

Draws lines where the depth or the surface direction changes, for a toon or technical-drawing look. Give it a selection mask to outline only those objects instead, through other objects with x-ray.

<EffectDemo effect="outline" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { outline } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/outline';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(outline({ preset: 'toon' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.thickness = 1.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type                                                          | Default             | Range      | Description                                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thickness`            | number                                                        | `1.5`               | 0.5 – 6 px | Line width.                                                                                       |
| `color`                | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles))     | `'#7cc4ff'`         |            | Line color.                                                                                       |
| `depthThreshold`       | number                                                        | `0.1`               | 0.005 – 1  | How sharply depth must bend (relative to its distance) to count as an edge.                       |
| `normalThreshold`      | number                                                        | `0.4`               | 0.02 – 2   | How sharply the surface direction must turn to count as a crease.                                 |
| `edges` _(structural)_ | 'depthAndNormals' \| 'depth'                                  | `'depthAndNormals'` |            | Find silhouettes from depth only, or creases too from the normal buffer (one extra scene render). |
| `style`                | 'overlay' \| 'ink'                                            | `'overlay'`         |            | Draw lines over the image, or on plain paper.                                                     |
| `paper`                | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#f3efe6'`         |            | Ink style: background color.                                                                      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                                      |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toon`       | `color: '#101018'`, `thickness: 2`                                            |
| `blueprint`  | `style: 'ink'`, `paper: '#123a73'`, `color: '#d7e9ff'`, `thickness: 1`        |
| `sketch`     | `style: 'ink'`, `color: '#2b2b33'`, `thickness: 1.2`, `normalThreshold: 0.25` |
| `silhouette` | `edges: 'depth'`, `color: '#ffd166'`, `thickness: 2.5`                        |

Apply one with `outline({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Geometry buffers:** depend on its settings; with the defaults it reads depth and normals.
- **Masks:** reads its `mask` itself rather than fading by it (see the description); any [mask kind](/guide/masks) works.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/outline`, including the shared effect runtime.

### Selection outlines

With a mask, the outline traces the mask instead of the geometry: give it a selection to outline chosen objects, and add `xray: true` to keep the outline visible through objects in front.

```ts
const hover = outline({ color: '#ffd166', thickness: 2 });
hover.mask = { selection: [pickedMesh], xray: true };
```

Without a mask, edges come from depth and, unless `edges` is `depth`, from a normal prepass. Both tests use second differences, so flat floors at grazing angles and smoothly curved surfaces stay clean while silhouettes and creases are drawn.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Edge detection from the second difference of inverse depth and of view-space normals; outer outline by dilating a selection mask.
